claims.exact_claim: The source stops BMW i3 polling when D-CAN is shut down, so silence can represent an asleep bus rather than an absent route.
claims.scope: BMW i3-like platforms only
claims.action_if_connected: Record asleep/state-limited separately from route absent.
claims.promotion_test: Reproduce the awake-to-asleep transition with timestamped bus and diagnostic evidence.

claims.exact_claim: The source models a Volt/Ampera silent-charging state where selected diagnostic routes can remain useful.
claims.scope: Chevrolet Volt / Opel Ampera implementation only
claims.action_if_connected: Preserve silent charging as a vehicle state instead of treating partial silence as absence.
claims.promotion_test: Capture the same routes in off, awake and silent-charging states on a compatible vehicle.

claims.exact_claim: The source distinguishes Bosch, Nidec and Bosch CAN-FD Honda platform families.
claims.scope: Honda/Acura platforms represented by openDBC
claims.action_if_connected: Classify transport and platform before applying a Honda route grammar.
claims.promotion_test: Match VIN/platform and at least one ECU fingerprint before activating platform routes.

claims.exact_claim: The source uses a distinct multi-route polling layout for Ioniq 5 / EV6 E-GMP vehicles.
claims.scope: Ioniq 5 / Kia EV6 E-GMP only; not automatically the Kona
claims.action_if_connected: Classify E-GMP versus older Kona/Soul architecture before selecting routes or read semantics.
claims.promotion_test: Fingerprint responsive ECUs on the project Kona and compare them with a source-supported platform tuple.

claims.exact_claim: The Mazda make-level source contains service-22 route 0x6F5 to 0x6FD for HV charger data; existing 0x700/0x708 and 0x720 material is not duplicated here.
claims.scope: Mazda make-level dataset; platform applicability unknown
claims.action_if_connected: Try 0x6F5/0x6FD as a candidate before broad enumeration on an electrified Mazda.
claims.promotion_test: Read identity on the route and confirm it on a real Mazda platform before promotion.

claims.exact_claim: Public Outlander research uses non-default sessions and broad experimental probing, which is evidence of proprietary research complexity rather than a safe product scan.
claims.scope: Experimental Outlander PHEV research only
claims.action_if_connected: Keep automatic Mitsubishi enumeration disabled; allow passive and standard identity paths only.
claims.promotion_test: Require an independently validated read-only allowlist with default-session behavior before enabling any route.

claims.exact_claim: The source states that Nissan Leaf polling does not respond while the car is off.
claims.scope: Nissan Leaf / e-NV200 implementation only
claims.action_if_connected: Record vehicle-off silence as conditions/state limited before concluding route absence.
claims.promotion_test: Repeat an exact route while off and awake on a project vehicle.

claims.exact_claim: The source catalogue documents recurring PSA ECU routes across powertrain, chassis, body and comfort modules.
claims.scope: Supporting provenance only; individual routes retain their existing project evidence states
claims.action_if_connected: Use existing map ordering and never overwrite C4 route outcomes or adapter-path limitations.
claims.promotion_test: Confirm each previously untested route on a compatible vehicle and fingerprint the responding ECU.

claims.exact_claim: The Skoda make-level source contains service-22 routes 0x70B/0x775, 0x70E/0x778 and 0x70F/0x779.
claims.scope: Skoda make-level dataset; model applicability unknown
claims.action_if_connected: Prioritize these candidates before generic enumeration while preserving model uncertainty.
claims.promotion_test: Confirm route identity and model/year applicability on a real Skoda.

claims.exact_claim: The Subaru make-level source contains service-22 routes 0x753/0x75B for TPMS and 0x7A2/0x7AA for engine data; the unpaired 0x746 command is not imported as a route.

claims.promotion_test: Confirm module identity and route response on a non-Solterra Subaru.

claims.exact_claim: The source defines Tesla-specific harnesses and buses for firmware queries, so standard OBD-path silence is not proof of vehicle incompatibility.
claims.scope: Tesla platforms represented by openDBC
claims.action_if_connected: Require an identified supported harness/bus path before active Tesla-specific queries.
claims.promotion_test: Validate the exact harness, bus and firmware-query response on supported hardware.

claims.exact_claim: The Polestar 2 source uses D016 and D01A proprietary headers with explicit priority/tester metadata for service-22 signals.
claims.scope: Polestar 2 / matching CMA-SPA2 only
claims.action_if_connected: Preserve priority and tester metadata; do not collapse these into normal-fixed symmetric addressing.
claims.promotion_test: Reproduce the request and response addressing with a raw project capture before runtime activation.

claims.promotion_test: Fingerprint the responding ECU (F187/F191/F195) and reproduce the same route+DID+decoder on a second SEAT of the same platform before promoting to uds-map.json.
